import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1);
    static final double EPS = 1e-6;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static long[] inv;
    static long[] p;
    static int maxn = 250015;
    static long[][] dp = new long[20][250005];
    static List<Integer> megumi = new ArrayList<>();
    static long mod;
    static int k;

    static void CNumberInit(int MAXNUM, long mod) {
        inv = new long[MAXNUM + 1];
        p = new long[MAXNUM + 1];
        inv[0] = inv[1] = 1;
        p[0] = p[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= MAXNUM; i++) {
            inv[i] = (mod - mod / i) * inv[(int)(mod % i)] % mod;
            p[i] = p[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= MAXNUM; i++) {
            inv[i] = inv[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod;
        }
    }

    static long qmod(long a, long b, long c) {
        long ret = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ret = ret * a % c;
            a = a * a % c;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        CNumberInit((int) (n + 5), mod);

        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(qmod(k, n, mod));
        } else {
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i += 2) {
                if ((i & n) == i) {
                    megumi.add(i);
                }
            }
            long ans = 0;
            dp[0][(int) n] = 1;
            int limit = Math.min(17, k);
            for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
                int tmpans = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < megumi.size(); j++) {
                    int megumiVal = megumi.get(j);
                    if (dp[i - 1][megumiVal] == 0) continue;
                    int Megumi = megumiVal & (megumiVal - 1);
                    int step = Megumi ^ megumiVal;
                    for (int kVal = step; kVal <= Megumi; kVal += step) {
                        if ((kVal & Megumi) == kVal) {
                            long val = dp[i - 1][megumiVal] * p[megumiVal] % mod
                                    * inv[kVal] % mod * inv[megumiVal - kVal] % mod;
                            dp[i][kVal] = (dp[i][kVal] + val) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                    tmpans = (tmpans + dp[i - 1][megumiVal]) % mod;
                }
                ans += tmpans * qmod(k - i, 1, mod) % mod;
            }
            ans = ans * p[(int) k] % mod;
            long temp = qmod(k, n, mod) - ans;
            ans = (temp % mod + mod) % mod;
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }
}
